answer_1.quote: The translation quality estimation (QE) task aims to evaluate the quality of a translation based on the translation and the source sentence without using reference translations.

answer_2.quote: We evaluated our model on the development set after every 1000 training batches and saved the checkpoint that achieved the highest Pearson correlation on the development set.

answer_4.quote: Direct Assessment (DA: requiring human assessors to assign an absolute score to a translation) or Relative Ranking (RR: requiring human assessors to rank different translations).
answer_4.guideline: Human assessors assign absolute scores or rank translations based on general translation quality.
